artPlates.title: From signal to understanding
artPlates.job: Establish the lab's identity through continuous waveform and discrete sample rhythm.
artPlates.equivalent: A 2 Hz ideal reference becomes four samples over one second at 3 Hz. This is generated art, not acquisition.
artPlates.scale: Entrance identity study · 1280 × 900 vector master; viewing-distance and mounting review pending

artPlates.title: A rhythm above the room
artPlates.job: Develop the existing segmented-fin installation with a readable assembly and light study.
artPlates.source: ARTWORK-CAND04 · existing P8-B sculpture concept / P4-D circulation zone
artPlates.equivalent: Waveform-shaped fins resolve into discrete illuminated segments. Separate frame, fins and replaceable light modules are candidates; no structure or photometry is certified.
artPlates.scale: Installation study · schematic assembly; no fabrication dimensions

artPlates.title: Read the conditions, keep the evidence
artPlates.job: Make aligned frontal and side-light illustrations readable with their source and condition labels.
artPlates.equivalent: Both plates show the same illustrative objects and framing. Frontal light has short authored shadows; side light has longer authored shadows. No camera frames, detector accuracy or causal measurement is asserted.
artPlates.scale: Conditions atlas · aligned illustration plates with identical framing

artPlates.title: Predict before sampling
artPlates.job: Tell the E01 learning sequence through a restrained five-frame storyboard.
artPlates.equivalent: Predict, prepare the signal kit, inspect 3 Hz samples, compare with 20 Hz samples, then write a supported reflection. The sampling model does not replace acquisition.
artPlates.scale: E01 storyboard · five illustrated steps and text equivalent

artPlates.title: Change the light, own the interpretation
artPlates.job: Tell the E06 sequence while keeping illustration and student interpretation distinct.
artPlates.equivalent: Predict, match the full kit, observe a frontal illustration, compare the side-light illustration, then reflect on what the illustration cannot establish.
artPlates.scale: E06 storyboard · five illustrated steps and text equivalent

artPlates.title: Every part belongs to the kit
artPlates.job: Give each capture component its canonical identity without substituting an invented inventory.
artPlates.equivalent: The capture kit includes CV-02, C1, C1-CAM, both C1-L1 and C1-L2, TRP-04 and CAL-01. Shapes are schematic and do not establish current availability or calibration.
artPlates.scale: Equipment illustration plate · canonical component labels

artPlates.title: One vocabulary from door to return
artPlates.job: Carry existing S-01–S-06 sign identities through entrance, zone, station, asset, restriction and safety touchpoints.
artPlates.source: P7-A signage family · P4-D destination anchors
artPlates.equivalent: Entrance identifies the subject; zone and station signs match the booking; the asset tag gives a typed ID; a restriction tag names only the equipment consequence; the safety reference points to posted local procedures.
artPlates.scale: Sign family · six individual vector studies; sizes/installation require local review

artPlates.title: Evidence first, interpretation second
artPlates.job: Provide an authored report/presentation spread using a clear figure, caption and evidence hierarchy.
artPlates.source: U08 authored spread · REF-2HZ-v1 generated signal and illustrative fault dependency
artPlates.equivalent: The main generated signal figure is separated from the supporting camera-to-kit consequence diagram, source captions and limitations. This is a reusable visual master, not the final U10 report or deck.

artPlates.title: A sample becomes a pixel
artPlates.job: Inspect how each ideal sine sample maps to a normalized display value.
artPlates.source: REF-2HZ-v1 · 2 Hz / 1 V / 1 s mathematical model
artPlates.equivalent: For each sample v, display value is (v + amplitude) / (2 × amplitude). The mapping is a decorative display model, not calibrated luminance or measured energy.
artPlates.scale: Discrete interactive study · static default, no autoplay or animation

signStudies.title: PARALLAX
signStudies.job: Identify the subject at the main entry.

signStudies.title: C1 · Controlled capture
signStudies.detail: Match the kit and method before work
signStudies.job: Identify the destination without implying equipment readiness.

signStudies.title: CV-02
signStudies.detail: Match this station to your booking

signStudies.title: C1-CAM
signStudies.detail: Typed ID · passport · manual · issue record
signStudies.job: Provide a readable equipment lookup independent of QR/camera permission.

signStudies.title: C1-CAM · restricted

signStudies.title: Know the landmark
signStudies.job: Identify an existing safety point; this study is not approved emergency signage.

physicalStudies.title: Keep orientation separate from obstruction
physicalStudies.proposal: Retain the concept circulation spine, exit openings, turning space and CV-04 approach floor. Use destination IDs on existing signs rather than adding floor-standing art in the route.
physicalStudies.review: Survey the room, review concurrent movement, mounting and sight lines, and confirm local access/emergency procedures. Static geometric fit does not establish whole-class comfort or approved capacity.
physicalStudies.fallback: Posted local procedures and readable destination/station IDs; plan/list remain available without AI or 3D.

physicalStudies.title: Landmarks before decorative warnings
physicalStudies.owner: Institutional safety lead + qualified facilities staff
physicalStudies.proposal: Preserve the canonical equipment and exit landmarks. Separate electrical-control, capture-light/cable and exit-clearance review from artwork. Warning meaning comes from approved procedures, not an ambient colour effect.
physicalStudies.review: Confirm equipment type, suitability, access, emergency instructions, sign artwork and installations. These identifiers locate concept fixtures and give no equipment-use instruction or certified hazard assessment.
physicalStudies.fallback: Actual posted emergency instructions and designated staff remain authoritative. This reference places no calls and operates no power or alarm.

physicalStudies.title: Security cameras have a different purpose
physicalStudies.proposal: Locate the two concept security-camera markers separately from the C1 experiment camera. The entry notice should identify the approved surveillance purpose and responsible contact before installation.
physicalStudies.review: Purpose, lawful access, retention, staff visibility, signage and actual camera coverage require institutional decisions. Coverage is unverified; no viewing cones, monitoring feed, biometric attendance or readiness inference is supplied.
physicalStudies.fallback: Readable awareness notice and responsible contact after policy approval. Typed station/asset lookup does not require surveillance or camera permission.

physicalStudies.title: An opening does not establish airflow
physicalStudies.owner: Facilities ventilation lead + faculty method owner
physicalStudies.proposal: Show the assumed operable W1 and concept supply/extract terminals. W1 daylight and drafts can affect C1 repeatability; the capture partition and shielding need joint method/facilities review.
physicalStudies.review: Occupied airflow, outdoor conditions, opening suitability and terminal performance remain unmeasured. D1/D2 are exit landmarks, not ventilation controls. No universal air-quality threshold or guaranteed cross-flow is asserted.
physicalStudies.fallback: Approved manual facilities procedure and current source/freshness labels. Unconnected or stale readings cannot certify safe air.

physicalStudies.title: A ceiling study, not a structure
physicalStudies.proposal: Develop ARTWORK-CAND04 as a segmented-fin and replaceable-light candidate above the concept spine. Keep mounting separate from circulation, emergency lighting and capture task-light circuits.
physicalStudies.review: Suspension, clearance, stability, fire behaviour, glare, cleanability, driver access and replacement need qualified review. The schematic disassembly study specifies no fasteners, loads, products or fabrication dimensions.
physicalStudies.fallback: Static waveform/sample poster and physical text labels convey the same subject without powered artwork. No quantified energy saving follows.

physicalStudies.title: Follow the class through the touchpoints
physicalStudies.proposal: Desk scenario: arrival at D1; match booked station; collect the complete kit from STO-1; rotate through C1/S1; retain work during a fault; return every component; review at COL; depart by the approved local route.
physicalStudies.review: Simultaneous collection/return, queues, sight lines, cable movement, cleanup and assisted approach need a measured occupied-room review. The plan does not prove dynamic circulation or capacity.
physicalStudies.fallback: Same station/asset IDs, manually posted instructions and named staff recovery. No second operational register or automatic attendance is created.
